Source: https://github.com/RDFLib/prez-ui/tree/dc7778029666c7097fc5b44e5f623b7e06c82cc8/packages/prez-components/src
Version: 4.1.4 (tag v4.1.4)

The published package inlines all Mermaid diagrams into a single JavaScript
module. These component sources let Vite split dependencies normally instead.
Local changes: Literal.vue loads Mermaid on demand; type-only imports are
marked explicitly for Nuxt's Vue compiler; trailing whitespace is normalized.
The build plugin resolves
upstream @/ imports within this directory and uses the published stylesheet.
Keep the matching dependency version pinned; update these sources and build
adapters together when upgrading Prez Components.
